title: Loss Prevention Desk Standard: Lost, Stolen and Fraud-Review Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards
content:
**Standard.** A lost or stolen card of the Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards program can be frozen and replaced only when it is registered or the holder has the purchase receipt showing its number, as the type's replacement requirement states. Only the balance remaining when the loss is reported is protected; value spent before the report is not restored. A card can be frozen only while it is in active status. The replacement is a new card of the same type, with no fee, loaded with the protected balance by a balance transfer, and the old card is closed. A fraud review is completed within the type's fraud review period of 10 business days and either unfreezes the card or voids the fraudulent value.

Cards can be registered to a customer profile where the type allows registration, and replacement protects only the balance at the time the loss is reported.

## The active-status condition for freezing

- **What decides it.** The card's status in Northgate's own card record; a customer's account of the card does not decide it.
- **When it is read.** Before the card is frozen.
- **Which card.** The very card to be frozen, identified by its card record.

| Card status in the card record | Card can be frozen |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| issued, frozen, depleted, expired or canceled | no |

## Who can have a lost or stolen card frozen and replaced

| Type's replacement requirement | Card registered | Purchase receipt showing the card number | Freeze and replacement |
|---|---|---|---|
| registration or receipt | yes | either | available |
| registration or receipt | no | yes | available |
| registration or receipt | no | no | not available |
| registration | yes | either | available |
| registration | no | yes or no | not available |

## Card states through a loss or fraud case

- A card reported lost or stolen, or placed under fraud review, moves from active to frozen, with the reason recorded as lost or stolen, or fraud review.
- A fraud review that clears moves the card from frozen back to active; otherwise the review voids the fraudulent value.
- When a frozen card's balance is moved to its replacement, the old card is closed, moving from frozen to canceled with the replacement card recorded against it.

## Worked replacement (hypothetical amounts)

A registered Northgate Gift Card was loaded with 100.00, and 40.00 was spent before the holder reported it stolen. The protected balance is 100.00 less 40.00, which is 60.00. The holder receives a new Northgate Gift Card, with a replacement fee of 0.00, loaded with 60.00 by a balance transfer, and the stolen card is closed. The 40.00 spent before the report is not restored.
